name: JobsPipe: Search Companies Hiring for Role
description: Find all companies currently hiring for a specific role or job title
notes: Replace YOUR_JOBSPIPE_API_KEY with your actual API key
Change job_country_code_or to target specific countries (e.g., ['US', 'CA'])
order_by 'jobs' sorts by number of openings (use 'last_posted' for recency)
Returns companies ordered by hiring volume
Costs 1 credit per company returned (free if paid this month)
